requests.what: The harness receipt frob.gauntlet.receipt/1 must carry (1) stack_receipt (sr: form of BUILT_UNDER) and stack_dev, as N40-01 (rule on gate receipts, INV-SUITE-03) and N33a-06 state, with a dep on N33a-06; and (2) the producing binary's build_identity (dev-salt | depgraph-receipt, frob_core::stack::BUILD_IDENTITY_MODE), so the recorder can apply N33a-08's may_cite (no Performance or Parity pass from a dev-salt build), with a dep on N33a-08 (no cycle). Its field list has none of the three. N33a-07's admission records now cite this receipt as harness_receipt.

BD-220's e2e and acceptance use --no-memo (property no_memo) on eval.run and study.submit (the memo bypass of BD-111 and N28b-38: look nothing up, compute, still store); neither row in VERBS-eval or VERBS-study lists it. Same request as F-U28b and F-U33b made: register no_memo as a common input of every verb the memo wrapper wraps, so these two rows carry it.

Under --record the script writes the M0 admission records (INT-FSIM-01, INT-FSQL-01, INT-CUDA-01, INT-FT-01, INT-FSYM-01, -02, INT-FNP-01, -02) but nothing enters their rows in registries/gates.toml. Convention 9 and N33a-07 (now: the admission writer never writes gates.toml; a record carries harness_receipt) need each gate's tier run (FROB_TEST_SEED=<seed> cargo test -p frob-conformance --test <tier> --features gauntlet-mutations -- <gate>), the record citing that receipt, and the row entered with record_gate from it by this bead (as N33c-17, N33c-20 do); the script itself writes no row. The steps of BD-007, BD-015 and BD-019 run inside this script.

N33a-08 defines frob_core::stack::build_identity::may_cite(gate_class), which refuses a Performance or Parity pass from a dev-salt binary with dev-build-identity, and names record_gate as its one caller; the recorder neither calls it nor reads the producing binary's BUILD_IDENTITY_MODE. Add the refusal dev-build-identity (beside receipt-dirty-tree) and a test, with a dep on N33a-08 (no cycle); the mode reaches the recorder through the harness receipt (see the request to N38a-02).

Its admission is the step fnp_linalg_admission of scripts/e2e/airlock_groups.sh, which N33a-34 says each adding bead writes, but N33a-21 does not depend on N33a-34 (N33a-31, N33b-22 and N33bx-03..07 do; N33a-22 now does). Add dep N33a-34 (M1; no cycle) and say N33a-34 provides the script, its step table and the skip logic.
